title: I Was a Failed Day Trader Who Lost Everything, But After Being Reincarnated in Another World, My Textbook Technical Analysis Actually Works and Now I'm the Richest Man in the Kingdom!?
description:
The setup was right. The size was wrong. The truck was on time.

Ned Rose spent six years losing to machines that traded faster than thought. Then a delivery truck settled his final position, and he woke up in the Kingdom of Valdria: two moons overhead, a magic terminal in every pocket, and live candlestick charts glowing in every town square.

Here's the thing about Valdria. It has a national exchange, six hundred years of price records, brokers, clearinghouses, forward contracts. And not one single person who has ever computed a moving average. They trade on rumors. On omens. On what their fathers paid.

In a market like that, buy low RSI and sell high RSI isn't a strategy. It's a superpower.

Follow the whole ride, from ten sacks of barley to the richest man in the kingdom:

• Start with nothing. Sixteen silver shields, a cracked secondhand slate, and a head full of dead knowledge that suddenly works.

• Build a firm worth fighting for. A pawnshop prodigy who audits everything (including you), a gnome engineer building the world's first trading terminal, and a teenage front-runner who picks your pocket so well you hire him.

• Face a market that learns. Copycats print garbled pamphlets of your method. A cult chants your own disclaimer back at you. Your easy edge dies the same slow death it died on Earth.

• Survive the whale. Aldric Vane doesn't read markets. He arranges them. And he's quietly buying the one thing the entire kingdom needs to survive winter.

What makes it different:

• Real trading, really explained. RSI, short squeezes, pump and dumps, position sizing, market corners. Every concept is woven into the story and accurate enough that traders will grin and newcomers will accidentally learn how markets work.

• Authentic trader psychology. The 3 a.m. doubt, the revenge trade, the stop-loss you swear you won't move. If you've ever held a losing position, this story knows you.

• A complete arc. Volume 1 tells a full story with a proper ending, plus a hook that will make you very impatient for Volume 2.

• No status screens. No skill trees. No grinding. Just candlesticks, leverage, and the oldest boss fight in finance: your own hands.

A linear visual novel adapted faithfully from the novel. Sit back, read, and let the market come to you.

This is not financial advice.
description_short: A failed day trader dies at 3:47 a.m. and wakes in a world where his textbook technical analysis actually works. Get rich, get famous, get hunted. A visual novel about candlesticks, courage, and one very patient whale. This is not financial advice.
